title: OUSD - Yield-Bearing, Well-Pegged, Scalable Cardano Stablecoin

ms.promise: A financial engineering consultant with qualifying experience in the blockchain Real World Asset sector and the regulatory landscape of custodial entities and compliance will be contracted to conduct a thorough review of the initial OUSD system architecture. The resulting report serves to validate the underlying system logic, risk assessments, and yield strategies utilized in the system by consulting with industry leaders in capital management, real world assets, and robust protocol design.
ms.criteria:
・A PDF report based on the consultation linked on Optim's public Gitbook with all information, findings, considerations and improvements recommended by the consulting party as part of the review process 
・A list of the consultant's qualifications, a link to their LinkedIn profile will be provided

The qualifications of the consultant will be, at minimum, having experience/having previously been:
- Hired by IOHK / IOG for stablecoin consulting 
-Math, Physics, or Enginnering degree from US Top 20 University
-10+ years professional experience in finance and software engineering

ms.promise: The Optim Labs team will be taking recommendations from the consultant review into consideration to make any improvements and adjustments to the overall system architecture, collateral risk profiles and planned algorithmic market operations. The resulting finalized technical specification will then be used to communicate the system design with the smart contract engineering team to start development of the application.
ms.criteria: The system design specification document will outline the core components of the OUSD Stablecoin system. It will break down each essential element, explaining the system's architecture, operation, any off-chain entity implementation, flow of funds, and reserve capital management.

ms.promise: The system design specification from the previous milestone will be implemented using Aiken and/or Plutus V3 to develop the core sets of smart contracts for the OUSD stablecoin system. The resulting open sourced codebase will be deployed on a private testnet or limited-assets non-public mainnet for internal verification and thorough testing of system logic, core mechanisms and key components. A video walkthrough describing the functionalities of these smart contracts will be presented where the lead developer will explain a high level overview of the OUSD system for Catalyst reviewers to familiarize themselves with the codebase.
ms.criteria:
Open sourced Aiken or Plutus V3 codebase that implements core system design specification components.
Video of code walkthrough to describe the smart contract mechanism and working live interactions of a private testnet or limited-assets non-public mainnet deployment for non-technical milestone reviewers and the broader Catalyst community to understand the scope of the system.

A UX/UI design will be crafted to visualize the functionality and structure of the OUSD user interface. This will serve as a visual representation for the finalized web app frontend, detailing the user journey and flow of interactions of navigating the application from the end users’ perspective. This interface will form a cohesive brand identity with the rest of Optim’s suite of products to familiarize the user with a similar user experience across its own ecosystem.
**Reviewers, if confused, should refer back to the original proposal and read more carefully where the original Catalyst Proposal approved by voters states: 
 "User Interface and User Experience development: Figma mockups of the application will be sketched and iterated upon with the help and feedback from core Optim DAO contributors, as they have very successfully helped in this regard with our previous products.
